top_news.title: AI Gateway, Web Search API - Introducing Web Search API
top_news.dek: Cloudflare launches a beta Web Search API for AI agents to ground responses in real-time data.

top_news.title: Inside-Out AI: Rebuilding Airbnb Behind the Scenes and Across the Guest Experience
top_news.dek: Former Meta generative AI lead Ahmad Al-Dahle is spearheading an AI-driven transformation at Airbnb.
top_news.brief: As Airbnb's CTO, Al-Dahle is applying his experience from the Llama model development to overhaul both internal product development workflows and the end-to-end guest experience on the platform.

top_news.title: Google: The latest AI news we announced in September 2026
top_news.dek: Google's September 2026 update highlights the release of Gemini 4 Argon and new connected app integrations.
top_news.brief: The latest updates include the rollout of the Gemini 4 Argon model and expanded capabilities for Connected Apps within the Gemini ecosystem. Additionally, Google introduced WeatherNext 3, showcasing ongoing integration of generative AI across its core product suite.
top_news.image_alt: Google Gemini logo and interface elements

top_news.title: Kolibri is an open-weight LLM from Aleph Alpha for German and English
top_news.dek: Aleph Alpha has released Kolibri, a 78B parameter mixture-of-experts model optimized for German and English.
top_news.brief: Kolibri is an open-weight LLM released under the Apache 2.0 license. It utilizes a mixture-of-experts architecture, activating approximately 3.5 billion parameters per token. The model was trained from scratch on infrastructure located in Germany and Finland.

top_news.title: AI agents build 3D scenes from photos but have no idea if they got it right
top_news.dek: LEGO-Anything converts single images into editable Blender code, though agents struggle to verify geometric accuracy.
top_news.brief: The LEGO-Anything framework uses a coding agent to generate executable Blender scripts from single photos, allowing for scene editing and analysis. While effective at reconstruction, benchmarks show that current agents lack the ability to self-evaluate the geometric accuracy of their output, performing no better than random chance.
top_news.image_alt: LEGO-Anything overview showing code generation from a single photo

primary.summary: A new approach called LEGO-Anything turns single photos into editable Blender code for 3D scenes.
